title: Unfinished
novel: Barney decided to use his best [[tactics|tactic]] to woo Ted into designing the new GNB building. He treated Ted like a woman he was trying to [[impress|impress]] at a bar. He sent Ted flowers, [[complimented|compliment]] his work, and even showed up at his apartment with wine. Ted was [[amused|amuse]] by the whole thing but also [[tempted|tempt]] by the offer. The building project was a huge [[opportunity|opportunity]] for his career. Meanwhile, Robin was [[struggling|struggle]] with her feelings for Don. Late one night, she [[drunk-dialed|drunk-dial]] him and left a [[rambling|rambling]] message on his voicemail. The next morning, she [[regretted|regret]] it immediately. She felt [[embarrassed|embarrass]] and begged her friends to help her [[retrieve|retrieve]] the message before Don could hear it. Ted told Barney that he would accept the GNB project, but only if he could design it his own way. Barney [[agreed|agree]] without hesitation. He knew that once Ted was [[hooked|hook]], the deal was as good as done. Robin eventually learned that Don had already heard the message. To her surprise, he thought it was funny and not at all [[pathetic|pathetic]]. She felt a small sense of [[relief|relief]], though she knew she needed to move on. The gang met at MacLaren's that evening and [[celebrated|celebrate]] Ted's new project. Barney raised his glass and declared that he was the greatest wingman in the history of [[architecture|architecture]]. Everyone laughed, and for once, the evening felt [[peaceful|peaceful]].

tactic.en: a method used to achieve a goal

compliment.en: to say nice things about someone

amuse.en: to make someone laugh or smile

tempt.en: to make someone want to do something

opportunity.en: a chance to do something good

struggle.en: to try very hard to do something

rambling.en: going on and on without clear direction

regret.en: to feel bad about something you did

retrieve.en: to get something back from somewhere

agree.en: to have the same opinion as someone

hook.en: to catch or attract someone's interest

pathetic.en: causing feelings of sadness or pity

relief.en: a feeling of comfort after worry ends

celebrate.en: to do something special for a happy event
